parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood with a rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the base and door, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of MDF for stability and load distribution.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures balance and stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel of the cabinet, made of solid wood and attached with hinges for access.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the cabinet to access stored items, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, allowing access to the cabinet interior.
